messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Inferring Stan Users
parts:
Using the GitHub API we're able to get a bit more information about our user base. Although we can't get stats on the number of downloads of the source code itself, we do have stats on the number of downloads of the manual. As of today there have been 2842 downloads of the Stan v2.0.1 manual.

Commence random speculation of what that implies for our active user base.

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: Inferring Stan Users
parts: For future reference, those listed as collaborators can access these stats by calling the API route https://api.github.com/repos/stan-dev/stan/releases.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: Inferring Stan Users
parts:
That's roughly in line with what we were seeing when
we had reporting on Google code.

I suspect most of our users are using RStan or PyStan,
which have separate downloads. But there's only a single
manual download point.

As a user, I often download things like the manual multiple
times if I can't find where I left the last one.

But given we're over 550 on the users group, this seems
about right if 1/4 users register for the users group.

- Bob
